annotations.title: Check a list of songwriters by IPI name number

description: Use when the user has several IPI name numbers, such as the writers on a song, a catalogue or a registration file, and wants to know who each one is, or whether some of a writer's works sit under another spelling or number. Up to 50 numbers per call. For each: the person holding it, their registered names, works in total and on their main number, works_elsewhere (registered only under another spelling or number), and a person_url.
name: check_writers
title: Check a list of songwriters by IPI name number
